scope: Bounded indicators in CR3 BMFF headers, Canon CMT TIFF directories and embedded JPEG marker envelopes. Presence causes refusal; absent matches do not certify authenticity or exclude unknown/remote provenance. Identifier detection is not cryptographic validation or official CR3 support by C2PA.

entries.location: uuid boxes reached through declared BMFF containers
jumb/jumd description in bounded JPEG APP11 JP assembly; repeated continuation headers checked
CMT1/CMT2 EXIF TIFF directories and embedded JPEG EXIF APP1 TIFF directories
CMT3 Canon directory; conservative indicator refusal even for a zero/malformed data reference; no pointer followed

uninspectableOrUnproved: unknown UUID/container/leaf payloads and compressed sensor data
generic JUMBF, unsupported APP11 sequence/box grammar, extended JUMBF lengths
embedded preview maker notes and unknown signature namespaces
XMP/remote/sidecar/external credentials and arbitrary unknown-signature schemes
